source: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract, state-wise population (persons), as reproduced in Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Andaman & Nicobar Administration, Basic Statistics 2024-25, Table 32 (p.123). https://ecostat.andamannicobar.gov.in/basicstatPDF2024_25/33.populationcensus.pdf
note: Keys are LGD state codes (places/in_states.geojson). Code 38 = Dadra & Nagar Haveli plus Daman & Diu, summed from census codes 26 and 25 (the two were merged in 2020). Telangana (36) and Ladakh (37) were part of Andhra Pradesh and Jammu & Kashmir in 2011 and are not given separately, so they are left uncoloured. West Bengal (19) is excluded from the state fill: its districts are shaded from the district table.
